correctness.rationale: An independent two-pole/two-pentagon graph construction gave all 5,888 augmented faces, and propagation of all oriented triangle images yielded all 120 automorphisms, classified by the boundary orientation. An independently chosen acyclic Morse matching has 121 critical 3-cells and 57 critical 4-cells only; its integral boundary by signed forward elimination has Smith factors 56 units and 3, proving H3=Z^64⊕Z/3 and integral H4=0. On the original simplicial face set the negative augmented signed Lefschetz sum is the H3 character. For rotational orders 1,2,3,5 I found (64,0,−2,−1) for rotations and (16,0,−2,1) for antipodal multiples, constant on all the corresponding elements even when the order-5 class splits. The even and odd A5 rows are (40,0,−2,0,0) and (24,0,0,−1,−1). Inner products with V4=(4,0,1,−1,−1), V5=(5,1,−1,0,0), and the V6 sum row (6,−2,0,1,1), dividing the V6 inner product by two, give exactly (2,4,2) and (2,2,1), without trivial constituents. Independently of the Morse matching I split the original signed mod-3 chain spaces into antipodal ± eigenbases, taking signed orbit sums and differences. In each parity dim C4=741; for + the ranks of ∂4,∂5 are 686,55 and for − they are 670,70. Hence the unique H4(F3) line is odd. Natural UCT with integral H4=0 identifies it with Tor(H3(Z),F3); antipodal inversion is −1 on the integral order-three subgroup. The rotational action is necessarily trivial because A5 is perfect and Aut(Z/3) is abelian.
residual_risks: The independent checks determine the rational representation and the characteristic torsion subgroup, not the integral free lattice or an equivariant homotopy model.

value.rationale: The full symmetry action on the planar three-torsion example is a natural and useful exact invariant, and the independent calculations corroborate it. As a submitted narrow invariant, however, the entire claimed datum is already available in an equivalent indexed record, with the torsion sign also in a demonstrably earlier result. This submission does not give a distinct mathematical result such as an integral free-lattice description or an equivariant homotopy theorem; its finite certificate is not offered as a new general method.
residual_risks: The negative judgment is about the contribution beyond existing coverage, not the intrinsic usefulness of knowing the invariant.
